PLUM Reporting

Periodically Listing Updates to Management

This website contains data on policy and supporting positions in the executive branch of the federal government and other federal entities outlined in 5 U.S.C. 3330f). Individual agencies are responsible for the accuracy, completeness, reliability and up-to-date status of the information listed.

The U.S. Office of Personnel Management is publishing data reported by agencies as of June 15, 2026.  Agency certifications can be found at https://www.opm.gov/about-us/open-government/plum-reporting/agency-certification/.
